title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager

We are looking for a Product Manager with 3–5 years of experience to help build AI\-first digital

solutions for real business and user problems.

Eligibility: B.Tech / B.E. from IITs or other leading engineering institutes

Key responsibilities

 Define product vision, roadmap, requirements, and success metrics for AI\-enabled

products.

 Work closely with engineering, data/AI, design, and business teams to take products

from idea to launch.

 Convert customer needs and business problems into clear user stories, PRDs, and

product specifications.

 Identify high\-value use cases for AI Implementation, machine learning, automation, and

intelligent workflows.

 Track product adoption, user feedback, quality, and commercial impact; drive

continuous improvement.

 Conduct market, competitor, and user research to strengthen product differentiation.

 Should be able to create reports and management presentations

 Should be able to work on excel and PowerPoint to create plans and management

updates

Preferred Candidate Profile

 3–5 years of experience in product management, consulting, technology, or building

digital products.

 Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability, with excellent written and verbal

communication.

 Understanding of AI/ML, LLMs, APIs, data products, and digital workflows; hands\-on

coding experience and use of Codex/Claude/Co\-pilot is a plus.

 Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and collaborate across technical and

business teams.

 Ownership mindset, customer focus, and curiosity to build practical AI\-led solutions.

 Should have done schooling from English Medium

 Should be well versed with using Excel sheets and Powerpoint presentations

Pay: ₹400,000\.00 \- ₹900,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Manager - Product Development
description:
**Company:** SWT CLUB Pvt. LTD.  
**Industry:** Travel \& Tourism  
**Location:** Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**Working Days:** 6 Days – Monday to Saturday  
**Weekly Off:** Sunday  
**Salary:** As per Market Standards

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Senior Manager – Products** to lead and strengthen our product portfolio across **Domestic and International destinations**. The ideal candidate should have strong destination knowledge across **both long\-haul and short\-haul markets**, along with excellent communication, product development, marketing, and business development skills.

The candidate will be responsible for developing, managing, and improving travel products that are commercially viable, competitive, and aligned with market demand.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the **development, planning, and management of Domestic and International travel products**.
* Build and maintain a strong portfolio covering **Short\-Haul and Long\-Haul destinations**.
* Identify new destinations, products, experiences, and travel trends with strong commercial potential.
* Develop competitive **itineraries, packages, pricing structures, and product offerings**.
* Coordinate with DMCs, hotels, airlines, suppliers, and other travel partners to negotiate competitive rates and services.
* Regularly review existing products and improve them based on **market demand, customer feedback, sales performance, and competition**.
* Work closely with the **Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Business Development teams** to ensure successful product launches and sales.
* Support the sales team with **product training, destination knowledge, presentations, and sales tools**.
* Develop product strategies to increase revenue, margins, and overall business growth.
* Conduct competitor and market analysis to identify **pricing, product gaps, and new business opportunities**.
* Maintain strong relationships with international and domestic suppliers and negotiate commercially beneficial contracts.
* Participate in **travel trade shows, B2B events, destination workshops, roadshows, and supplier meetings**.
* Create and support marketing campaigns for new and existing products.
* Track product performance and prepare regular **MIS, sales, profitability, and market reports** for management.
* Lead and mentor the product team and ensure timely execution of product\-related activities.

**Required Knowledge \& Skills**

* **7–8 years of relevant experience** in Product Management / Product Development within the **Travel \& Tourism industry**.
* Strong knowledge of **Domestic and International destinations**.
* Good understanding of both **Short\-Haul and Long\-Haul international markets**.
* Strong knowledge of travel products, destinations, hotels, sightseeing, transfers, experiences, and itinerary planning.
* Excellent **communication and presentation skills**.
* Strong **marketing and business development skills**.
* Excellent negotiation, vendor management, and relationship\-building abilities.
* Strong commercial understanding with the ability to analyse **pricing, margins, and product profitability**.
* Good understanding of B2B travel and trade requirements.
* Strong market research and competitor\-analysis skills.
* Ability to identify new opportunities and convert them into commercially successful products.
* Proficiency in preparing product presentations, reports, and business proposals.
* Strong leadership, decision\-making, and team\-management skills.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should be a **travel product specialist** with strong destination knowledge and a commercial mindset. The candidate should be capable of independently managing the product lifecycle—from **destination research and supplier negotiation to product creation, pricing, marketing, sales support, and performance analysis**.

**Compensation \& Work Schedule**

**Salary:** As per market standards, commensurate with experience and expertise.  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Weekly Off:** Sunday  
**Location:** Noida

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Role Description**  
This is a full\-time, on\-site Relationship Manager role based in Noida. The Relationship Manager will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with customers, managing their financial portfolios, and providing tailored banking solutions. Daily tasks include identifying customer needs, offering advice on banking products and services, achieving sales targets, generating new business, and ensuring customer satisfaction through personalized service.

**Qualifications**

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively with customers and address their banking needs.
* Proficiency in financial and portfolio management, including knowledge of banking products and services such as loans, deposits, and investments.
* Sales and business development abilities, with a focus on achieving and surpassing targets.
* Problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to ensure customer satisfaction.
* Knowledge of local markets and industries, particularly in agriculture and retail banking, is advantageous.
* Proficiency in using banking software and tools for efficient customer relationship management.
* Educational qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA or equivalent is a plus.
* Previous experience in a similar role, especially in the banking or financial services industry, would be beneficial.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹70,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Are you open for branch banking sales?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Retail sales: 4 years (Required)

Location:

* Noida, Uttar Pradesh (Noida) (Required)

Work Location: In person
